title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Plant Organic HMW gDNA Extraction
author: Benjamin Jackson
materials: Proceed to appropriate QC checks and downstream processing.

steps.title: Prepare Direct Plant Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the Direct Plant Lysis Buffer and preheat it for 15–30 mins at 65 °C and 400 rpm to ensure total dissolution of reagents. Immediately prior to use, add DTT and Proteinase K and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Aliquot 65–100 mg of cryogenically disrupted tissue samples into individual 2 mL Lo-Bind tubes on dry ice, then transfer to wet ice for 10–15 minutes to equilibrate temperature.

steps.title: Perform Initial Sample Lysis
steps.instruction: Add 550 μL of preheated direct plant lysis buffer (65 °C) to the first sample, pulse vortex 5 times at full speed, and place on a heat block at 55 °C and 600 rpm. Repeat for all samples.

substeps.instruction: Inspect samples by inverting to mix once incubation begins.
Mix any samples with aggregated tissue using a wide bore p1000 until homogenous.

steps.title: RNase A Treatment
steps.instruction: After 15 minutes of incubation, add 4 µL RNase A to each sample (optionally diluted in 6 µL PBS per sample and added via Multipette) and mix by inversion to resuspend any aggregated, insoluble, or sedimented tissue particles.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the resuspension process for severely reaggregated samples.

steps.title: Complete Lysis Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate for another 45 minutes at 55 °C and 600 rpm. Do not agitate by mixing during the final 15 minutes of lysis to allow unlysed sediment to settle.

steps.title: Prepare Precipitation Tubes
steps.instruction: While samples are incubating, prepare fresh 2 mL Lo-Bind tubes containing 150 μL of cold potassium acetate (4 °C; 5 M; pH 7.4) for each sample and place on wet ice.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Remove samples from the heat block, allow lysate to settle for 5 mins at RT, and centrifuge for 10 minutes at 8,000 rpm at room temperature, ensuring the settled insoluble tissue is not disturbed prior to centrifugation.

steps.title: Precipitate gDNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to the tubes containing 150 μL cold potassium acetate (4 °C; 5 M; pH 7.4) using a wide bore p1000, and carefully mix by pipetting with the same wide bore until homogenous.

steps.title: Incubate Precipitate
steps.instruction: Incubate samples on wet ice for 5 minutes (up to one hour if needed). During this time, remove 500 μL Sera-Mag™ Speedbead solution and 175 μL AMPure® PB beads per sample from the fridge to reach room temperature, and pre-chill a tabletop centrifuge to 4 °C.

steps.title: First Chloroform Separation
steps.instruction: Perform the first chloroform separation in a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 μL cold chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (–20 °C; 24:1, v/v) to the samples.
Mix on a tube rotator at 25 rpm for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Transfer up to 700 μL of the aqueous phase (top layer) to a fresh 2 mL Lo-Bind tube using a wide bore p1000, aspirating from the top to avoid interphase contaminants.

steps.title: Second Chloroform Separation
steps.instruction: Perform the second chloroform separation in a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 μL cold chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (–20 °C; 24:1, v/v) to the sample.
Mix on a tube rotator at 25 rpm for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Transfer up to 600 μL of the aqueous phase (top layer) to the applicable empty well of the Sample Plate using a wide bore p1000, aspirating from the top.

steps.title: Prepare KingFisher Plates
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Sera-Mag™ SpeedBead solution to the sample wells of the POE Sample Plate. Label and fill the following plates:

substeps.instruction: POE Tip plate 1 (1 mL 96-well tip comb, no reagent)
POE Sample plate (1 mL: up to 600 μL aqueous phase + 500 μL Sera-Mag™ Speedbead solution)
POE Ethanol wash 1.1 (1 mL: 1 mL 80% ETOH)
POE Ethanol wash 1.2 (1 mL: 1 mL 80% ETOH)
POE Elution Plate 1 (1 mL: 400 µL Buffer EB)
POE Tip plate 2 (1 mL 96-well tip comb, no reagent)
POE Ethanol wash 2 (1 mL: 1 mL 80% ETOH)
POE Elution Plate 2 (200 µL: 135 µL Buffer EB)

steps.title: Run KingFisher Extraction
steps.instruction: Select the required DNA extraction protocol on the KingFisher™ Apex and load the filled plates onto the instrument following the on-screen instructions.

steps.title: Perform AMPure PB Bead SPRI
steps.instruction: When the instrument prompts that the 1X SpeedBead SPRI is finished, add 175 µL (0.45X) AMPure PB beads to each well containing sample in the POE Elution Plate 1, return the plate to the instrument, and continue the run.

steps.title: Recover and Store gDNA
steps.instruction: When the 0.45X AMPure PB SPRI is finished, remove the POE Elution Plate 2 and transfer the 135 µL sample eluate to an appropriate storage tube using a wide bore p200.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the sample at RT overnight to allow gDNA to solubilise.
Store the DNA at 4 °C.
